text: BAM share rose 0.02 percentage points over 24 hours and 0.04 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 32.8% of Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 23.6% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The window has 61 whale-driven leadership changes, so top-node movement is dominated by large-validator routing rather than broad validator churn.
